simple.meaning: רָזִי (râzîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “thinness.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רָזִי (H7334) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 24:16, with occurrences in Isaiah.

definitions.full: H7334. razi רָזִי noun [masculine] leanness, wasting ; — רָזִילִֿי Isa 24:16 (twice in verse) to me, wasting! (opposed to צְבִי ).
